about: Seconds each slow test of the two binaries with jobs of their own takes in CI (GitHub's Windows runner): measured from public CI run 45560489354 (planted sequentially with one test thread, standalone on libtest's threads). tools/ci/test-runner.mjs deals each binary's tests out to its jobs by these times; a test not listed counts as 0.5 s. A missing or stale time never drops a test, it only makes the jobs less even. To refresh: with one test thread a test runs from the verdict line (ok) of the test before it to its own, in the jobs' logs (gh run view <id> --log); list every test over a second.
